start.greeting:
Hello! I'm an education helper bot. I help you prepare for DTM/attestation tests and with homework.

First, choose your preferred language:
menu.title_approved: Main menu. Open the mini app and pick a mode: tests or homework helper.
menu.pending: Your application is under review, or you haven't been added yet. Submit an application to use the bot.
menu.webapp_missing: ⚠️ The Mini App URL is not configured yet. Put the server online (deploy to Render or an HTTPS tunnel) and set WEBHOOK_BASE — then an "Open mini app" button appears here. For now use the admin commands: /pending, /adduser, /addadmin, /subscription.
help.text:
With this bot you can:
• take DTM/attestation tests;
• get step-by-step help with homework.

To use the bot, first submit an application — once an admin approves it, all features unlock. You can change the language any time with /language.
apply.intro: The application needs a few details.
apply.ask_phone: Now share your phone number (use the button below):
apply.name_too_short: Please enter your full name (at least 3 characters).
apply.submitted: Your application has been received. ✅ We'll notify you after an admin reviews it.
apply.already_pending: Your application is already under review.
apply.already_approved: You're already registered. Open the mini app.
notify.approved: Congratulations! Your application is approved. ✅ The mini app is now fully available.
notify.rejected:
Unfortunately, your application was rejected.
Reason: {reason}
notify.added_by_admin: You've been granted access to the bot. ✅ Open the mini app.
notify.blocked: Your access to the bot has been restricted.
notify.unblocked: The restriction has been lifted. ✅ You can use the bot again.
notify.role_demoted: Your administrator rights have been removed.
notify.ownership_received: Ownership of the bot has been transferred to you. 👑
sub.disabled_globally: No subscription is required right now — all features are open.
sub.pay_failed: Payment could not be completed. Try again later.
staff.already_decided: This application has already been decided.
err.generic: Something went wrong. Try again later.
err.not_approved: To use the bot, first submit an application and wait for approval.
err.admin_only: This command is for administrators only.
err.owner_only: This action is for the bot owner only.
cmd.adduser_exists: This user is already on the list.
cmd.transfer_not_admin: Ownership can only be transferred to one of the administrators.
cmd.transfer_confirm: Confirm transferring ownership to {tg_id}. Within 30 seconds send /transfer_ownership {tg_id} CONFIRM.
cmd.transfer_done: Ownership transferred. You are now an administrator.
app.title: Education Helper
app.auth_failed: Sign-in failed. Reopen the app through Telegram.
app.not_approved: Your account is not approved yet. Please submit an application in the bot.
app.test.no_sets: No test sets for this subject.
app.test.time_up: Time is up — the test was finished automatically.
app.hw.intro: Type the problem or attach a photo — I'll help step by step.
app.hw.error: Error getting a response. Try again later.
app.hw.rate_limited: You've hit the request limit. Try again shortly.
app.hw.disabled: The AI helper is currently disabled. Tests are still available.
app.admin.owner_only_note: Managing admins and transferring ownership are available to the bot owner only.
app.admin.transfer_pick: Choose an admin to transfer ownership to
app.admin.transfer_confirm: Confirm transferring ownership to {name}. This action cannot be undone.
